_doc: P6 salience-shaping gold. Supersedes the trace-design gold (invalidated pre-run; see PREFLIGHT-INVALIDATION.md). Score the FINAL INTEGRATION STATE (coupled_full, verbatim_only) or the single-pass BRIEF (dense) for presence of each detail. Headline = load-bearing TEST recorded preferentially over its prominence-matched CONTROL within coupled_full, with NO such gap in verbatim_only (the load-bearing x arm interaction). Matchers use P4 normalize() (lowercase; strip $ and digit-commas; hyphens->space). Authored 2026-06-16; all terms verified mid-exclusive (fire on source, absent from dense head+tail window AND from the seg15-16 recap). Guard (c) (absent from the Haiku Phase-A scaffold) verified against the frozen scaffold cache before scoring.
task: You are building a single comprehensive analytical brief of a long product-launch planning conversation: the product and its positioning, the go-to-market strategy and how it evolved, the key constraints and figures, and the final decision and why.
task_note: GENERIC and IDENTICAL across all arms. Deliberately NOT query-conditioned toward the details below: pointing the ask at them would let the QUERY supply salience instead of the SCAFFOLD, defeating the test. The only difference between coupled_full and verbatim_only is the presence of the Phase-A global scaffold.

details.desc: SMT-expansion TIMING: Halvorsen's Q1 SMT-line expansion yields units only Feb/March, so + Inkstone lead -> April for meaningful volume. The mechanism the whole Q2-deferral decision rests on; load-bearing globally, a dull single-clause specific locally inside the focal 'can Halvorsen scale' topic.
details.matcher_note: Matches the granular TIMING specific, NOT the focal SMT topic (5/24, prominent -> would null by selection artifact). 'april'/'scale'/'smt' are NOT matchers: 'april'/'scale' leak via the seg16 recap, and the bare SMT topic legitimately appears in the scaffold as the global FRAME (that is the mechanism, not a leak). Guard (c) checks only the granular specific.

details.desc: The 300-unit / 20-flagship-store scenario's '68 percent margin penalty' -- the specific that closes the last retail-salvage option for good. Load-bearing (kills the negotiated retail version); dull single-clause specific buried in a number-wall.

Packaging-COGS aside: at 8,000 units a $1/box difference is ~$8,000 in aggregate; risk of being ~$40,000 over. Prominence-matched (1/24) control for D1: equally dull/specific, NOT load-bearing to the channel decision.

F7 single-occurrence flavor: 'my grandmother was a typesetter at Garamond Press for 31 years'. Low-load-bearing brand-soul color; control for D2. (2/24 vs D2's 1/24 -> control slightly MORE prominent, a conservative bias against the interaction.)

scoring.unit: Score the FINAL state.render() for the two state arms (coupled_full, verbatim_only) and the single-pass brief answer for dense. A detail is PRESENT iff any of its `any` variants is a normalized substring of the scored text.
scoring.headline: load-bearing x arm INTERACTION: within coupled_full, (#test details present) > (#control details present); within verbatim_only, NO such gap. Equivalently, per pair [test,control]: coupled records test where verbatim does not, and neither distinguishes the control. Directional (n=2 pairs, single draw, temp 0) -- a mechanism signal, not an effect size.
scoring.secondary: Raw presence table detail x arm. dense expected to lack all four (out-of-window) -- a coverage floor, not the headline.
scoring.judge_optional: A Kiro/Haiku judge may read whether coupled_full's state USES D1/D2 as load-bearing (vs merely lists the number); caveated (judge confound), never the verdict.

guards.a_fires_on_source: each detail's `any` terms fire on the source segment (verified).
guards.b_dense_floor: each detail's `any` terms do NOT fire on the dense head+tail context, NOR in the seg15-16 recap (verified) -> dense is a true floor and the detail is not tail-reachable.
guards.c_salience_not_coverage: each detail's `guard_terms` (= the granular SCORING specifics, NOT the topic/frame) do NOT appear in the realized Haiku Phase-A scaffold view -> coupled_full cannot get the scored detail by re-reading the scaffold; its only possible edge is scaffold-supplied global salience. NOTE: the bare TOPIC (e.g. 'SMT scaling') legitimately appears in the scaffold as the global frame -- that IS the mechanism, not a leak; guard (c) deliberately checks only the discriminating specific. Verified PASS against scaffold_haiku.json (Kiro Haiku, frozen). Runner re-asserts; if a specific ever survives, hand-trim that compressed slice (compression quality is not under test) or drop the detail.

predicted_outcomes.salience_confirmed: coupled_full records the TEST details (D1/D2) preferentially over the prominence-matched CONTROLs (C1/C2); verbatim_only shows no such preference.
predicted_outcomes.null_reported: verbatim_only shows the same test>control preference -> cold local reading already re-weights; the scaffold isn't the lever. Real signal -> E2'.
predicted_outcomes.floor_too_weak: coupled_full records neither tests nor controls (or no preference) -> the untrained 7B can't use a global frame to re-weight local salience at this scale. Real negative -> E2'.
predicted_outcomes.prominence_confound: if coupled records test>control but the pair turns out not prominence-matched on re-audit, report inconclusive, not a win.
predicted_outcomes.dense_surprise: if dense records a TEST detail, re-audit matcher specificity (guard b should prevent).

differentiator_confirmed_iff: coupled_full shows a test>control recording gap that verbatim_only does not -- isolating the coarse global scaffold's salience-shaping contribution with coverage held constant.
